caption: The Shopify install dialog of Essential Cart Drawer by Essential Apps, listing the access it needs: customer data (device and activity data), staff and contributor data (store owner) and store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, Online Store, Shopify admin, other data).

The app editor with the cart drawer marked Live, the message Cart Drawer was successfully published in your store, the Spend tiers settings and the preview of the drawer with a timer, a rewards bar that says All Rewards unlocked, two discount codes and a Secure checkout button; the store avatar in the bottom left corner is hidden.

The Plans page: a Development store box saying All features free, the Free plan at $0.00 a month for up to 30 orders monthly with a Choose this plan button, the 30 Day Money Back Guarantee and the two Questions; the store name in the bottom left corner is hidden.
The list of all nine plans: Essential 1 to 7 from $8.99 to $138.99 a month and Unlimited at $198.99, each with a Start 14 day trial button; the store name is hidden.
